tbesh_html:
Rehoboth = "wide places or streets"
one of the 4 cities built by Asshur or by Nimrod in Asshur located close to Nineveh
Another name of nin.veh (נִינְוֵה "Nineveh" H5210)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Rechoboth, a place in Assyria and one in Palestine
strongs_1890.derivation: or רְחֹבֹת; plural of H7339 (רְחֹב); streets;
